_about: The hand-kept words of the sketches' cards (the card generator's text file has the two fighters of the build). `never` has one plain line for each `never` row of the sketch in identity.candidates.json, in the same order; the card generator refuses to run when the counts differ.

cyborg_press.name: The Demon Cyborg as the Press
who: Mass that arrives late and all at once. He is slow to look at and then he is on you: a forearm plate, a hammer fist or a shoulder, coming down or straight through with his whole body behind it.
He works on the chest and the arms, the parts a clamp would hold. The clamps and throws themselves are not in this row: nobody in the game has them yet.
never: His hands are plates and hammers, never a blade hand.
He never kicks above the gut.

cyborg_courier.name: The Demon Cyborg as the Courier
who: The fastest thing in the fight. He is in, the blow is thrown from where the limb already is, and he is gone: elbows, knees and straight hands on short lines.
Nothing is wound up for show, and nothing is left out after it lands.
never: He never spins: he never turns his back.
He never kicks above the chest.

cyborg_hopper.name: The Demon Cyborg as the Hopper
who: He leaves the ground to hit. A knee carries him up or a heel brings him down, and the funnel tips with it.
The legs do the work. His arms stay below the rim, so his hands are quick, low and straight.
never: Nothing by hand or elbow comes down from above: his arms stay below the rim.
He never headbutts: his head sits inside the funnel.
His rising blows go to the gut and the chest, never the jaw or the head.
He never brings the sole of his foot down from above. That waits for Legal's ruling on the stomp, and nothing of his is a blow on a downed opponent.

empress.name: The Empress
who: She barely moves. One open hand held as a blade and the heel of her foot: one clean line or one cut downward, from a body that stays upright.
Each blow ends exactly where it was aimed, and then she is still again. Her mantle is not in this row: it is a limb of its own, and comes later.
never: She never closes her hand: no fist and no hammer fist.
She never spins: she does not turn her back on anyone.
She never leans her weight on anyone: no shoulder.
